questions.questionText:
Each of the factors of production earns an income.
What are the incomes for capital and enterprise?
capital enterprise

Malaysia is a mixed economy.
Which statement about a mixed economy is necessarily correct?

options.text: private industry will provide most of the manufactured goods
the government will provide public goods and may provide merit goods
the primary sector will employ most workers
the transport network will be heavily subsidised

questions.questionText:
Water is a scarce resource in Singapore because the island’s small geographical area means
there is little land on which to collect water for its 4.8 million people.
Which method would be least successful in tackling its water scarcity?

options.text: exempting large families from paying water taxes
introducing a water tax that rises as consumption rises
redirecting funds from education to schemes to purify rainwater

questions.questionText:
A person makes sandwiches at home for five hours each day. She makes 20 sandwiches per
hour, and she sells each sandwich for $2 each.
What is the opportunity cost if she takes a holiday on a working day?

In 2011, China’s steel mills bought more coal in order to increase their output. China is the
world’s largest consumer of coal.
How would this change be shown on a demand and supply diagram for coal?

options.text: a fall in price with a movement along the supply curve
a movement along the demand curve with a rise in price
a rise in price with a shift in the supply curve to the left
a shift in the demand curve to the right with a rise in price

questions.questionText:
In recent years, the demand for cars in Indonesia has become more price inelastic while the
supply of cars has become more price elastic.
Which combination of events could have caused these changes?
quality of public time taken to
transport produce a car

A large supermarket applied to build on land which was in an area of natural beauty. The local
government allowed the building, even though the natural beauty of the area would be lost,
because many jobs would be created and much needed income would be brought to the local
community.
Which economic ideas cannot be found in the above statement?

options.text: free market and the conservation of resources
opportunity cost and improved standards of living

questions.questionText: What is not a function of a trade union?

options.text: to arrange promotion for its members

questions.questionText:
When elderly people retire from work, they may receive a pension income that is lower than their
previous income.
How is the proportion of their income spent on healthcare and leisure likely to change?
healthcare leisure

A bus company wishes to recruit a qualified senior manager to be responsible for coordinating
bus timetables and managing staff. Some work will be required at night as the company also
operates bus services at night. It is offering a good salary.
Which applicant would be most likely to be offered the position?

options.text: a person employed as a manager of a small taxi company
a person employed as a supervisor in another bus company
a trade union representative from another bus company with extensive family commitments

questions.questionText: What is not usually associated with the existence of a monopoly?

A group of farmers form a partnership. They buy more machinery which they share in the
production of cereals.
What is a benefit of using more machinery?

options.text: it eliminates the need to train labour
it increases the productivity of each farmer
it reduces total capital costs of production

questions.questionText:
Large-scale organisations can suffer from problems of coordination between departments which
cause diseconomies of scale in the long-run.
What indicates that diseconomies of scale have set in?

options.text: average fixed costs begin to decrease
average variable costs begin to decrease
rate of growth of output begins to decrease

questions.questionText:
Which policy combination will have the greatest impact on increasing the level of total spending in
the economy?
government
taxation
spending

A toy company bought a $750000 batch of raw plastic from a local firm and moulded it into toys.
The total revenue from the toys was $1000000. The government demanded that the company
pay tax on this action.
What is the most likely tax that the company has to pay?

Russia exports wheat. In 2010, a bad harvest led the Russian government to prevent the export
of wheat, to ensure enough supplies were kept for domestic use.
What was the most likely outcome of the government’s action?

options.text: prices were fixed by the wheat producers
the amount produced was determined by the government
the price of wheat abroad fell
there was a redistribution of domestic production

questions.questionText: How is economic growth measured?

options.text: by an increase in consumer demand

What might have reduced the impact of that fall on the economy?

In 2014, farmers’ crops were destroyed by two months of bad weather. As a result, in that year,
they did not employ as many people at harvest time.
What type of unemployment would this cause?

The Human Development Index can be used to measure human development in countries.
Which measure would not be part of its calculation?

The ratio of males to females in Russia is 90 to 100.
What could explain this imbalance?

options.text: more women than men emigrate from Russia
ten male babies are born for every nine female babies
the infant mortality rate is higher among girls than boys
women have a longer life expectancy than men in Russia

Which country is most likely to be a developed country?
primary secondary service

options.text: countries become overdependent on each other

exchange market?
demand for Pakistan’s demand
Pakistan’s exports for imports
